name: Google Calendar
summary: Check upcoming events from one calendar (read-only).

steps.title: Open Google Calendar Settings
steps.text: Open Google Calendar Settings in your browser and click the calendar you want Pilot to read under "Settings for my calendars" on the left.

steps.title: Copy the Secret address in iCal format
steps.text: Scroll down to "Integrate calendar", find "Secret address in iCal format" (a link ending in .ics), and copy it. Never share this link publicly.

steps.title: Paste and test
steps.text: Give the calendar a short name (like Personal or School), paste the secret iCal link below, and press Test connection.

connected_text: Ask Pilot what is on your calendar whenever you like.
privacy: Your secret iCal link is treated like a password and kept only in data/settings.json on this computer. Access is strictly read-only and limited to the single calendar you chose; Pilot cannot add, edit, or delete events.
